questions_for_hospital: PT and OT recommend SNF and document moderate-to-maximal assist for transfers, toileting and dressing. Is there any newer PT/OT note showing independent ADLs and walking 100 ft?
Has the patient been taught and observed to self-inject enoxaparin?
Is outpatient or home health PT, and wound care for the stapled incisions, arranged after discharge?
Will a 30-day supply of discharge medications be sent?
Is there any history of aggressive behavior, substance use, or conservatorship/FSP?

claude_fit.reason: The chart contradicts the referral form: she needs moderate-to-maximal assist for toileting, dressing and transfers and walks only 15 ft with help, so ADL-1, ADL-2, ADL-3, MOB-3 and FORM-X2 are not met, and PT/OT recommend SNF. Re-refer if she later reaches independent ADLs and 100 ft ambulation.
